root_cause.text: Use of the wrong loop variable (i instead of j) in the hash algorithm unregistration path causes the same algorithm to be unregistered multiple times during driver detach, leading to a kernel panic.
root_cause.evidence: The patch fixes the bug by changing `crypto_unregister_ahash(&eip93_algs[i]->alg.ahash)` to `crypto_unregister_ahash(&eip93_algs[j]->alg.ahash)` inside the loop that iterates over all algorithms (`for (j = 0; j < ARRAY_SIZE(eip93_algs); j++)`).

    crypto: eip93 - Add Inside Secure SafeXcel EIP-93 crypto engine support
    
    Add support for the Inside Secure SafeXcel EIP-93 Crypto Engine used on
    Mediatek MT7621 SoC and new Airoha SoC.
    
    EIP-93 IP supports AES/DES/3DES ciphers in ECB/CBC and CTR modes as well as
    authenc(HMAC(x), cipher(y)) using HMAC MD5, SHA1, SHA224 and SHA256.
bic_trace_step.reason: In the function eip93_unregister_algs, within the EIP93_ALG_TYPE_HASH case, the code uses eip93_algs[i]->alg.ahash instead of eip93_algs[j]->alg.ahash (line: crypto_unregister_ahash(&eip93_algs[i]->alg.ahash);).
